title: From Prompt to Service: An SLM-Based Agent Orchestration Gateway for AI-Driven Virtual Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2606.03557v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As generative AI capabilities expand, AI-driven virtual worlds face a growing architectural challenge. Users interact through in-world interfaces in multimodal ways, yet their requests demand fundamentally different AI backend models and computational resources. Embedding these capabilities directly into virtual world systems reduces extensibility, complicates maintenance, and limits the ability to coordinate services distributed across edge and cloud infrastructure. This paper presents an SLM-based Agent Orchestration Gateway, a lightweight runtime coordination mechanism that decouples a virtual world client from heterogeneous AI backends through intent-driven service routing. An edge-deployed SLM classifies the semantic intent of each user prompt, a configurable service registry validates and resolves the routing decision, and the selected backend is invoked transparently, enabling new AI capabilities to be introduced in the virtua

translated_title: 从提示词到服务：面向AI驱动虚拟世界的基于小型语言模型（SLM）的智能体编排网关
translated_abstract: 随着生成式AI能力的不断扩展，AI驱动的虚拟世界面临日益严峻的架构挑战。用户通过世界内界面以多模态方式进行交互，但他们的请求需要完全不同的AI后端模型和计算资源。将这些能力直接嵌入虚拟世界系统会降低可扩展性、增加维护复杂性，并限制协调分布于边缘和云端基础设施的服务的能力。本文提出了一种基于小型语言模型（SLM）的智能体编排网关，这是一种轻量级的运行时协调机制，通过意图驱动的服务路由将虚拟世界客户端与异构AI后端解耦。部署在边缘的SLM对每个用户提示词的语义意图进行分类，可配置的服务注册表对路由决策进行验证和解析，随后透明地调用所选后端，从而能够在虚拟世界中引入新的AI能力。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于小型语言模型的智能体编排网关，通过边缘部署的SLM对用户提示词进行语义意图分类，并结合可配置的服务注册表验证路由决策，实现虚拟世界客户端与异构AI后端的解耦和透明化服务调用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an SLM-based Agent Orchestration Gateway that decouples virtual world clients from heterogeneous AI backends through intent-driven service routing, where an edge-deployed SLM classifies user prompt intents and a configurable service registry validates and resolves routing decisions for transparent backend invocation.
